c.n: I’m interested in the mechanisms behind human judgement and behaviour: how people interpret information, form mental models and make choices with limited attention. Personality, motivation, cognitive biases and context often explain the gap between what people say, intend and actually do.
c.tx: I’m interested in the mechanisms behind human judgement and behaviour: how people interpret information, form mental models and make choices with limited attention. Personality, motivation, cognitive biases and context often explain the gap between what people say, intend and actually do.

c.n: I combine interviews, usability testing and close observation to uncover these patterns, then translate them into clearer information architecture, decision points and interaction flows. Street and travel photography further sharpen my attention to behaviour, context and visual composition.
c.tx: I combine interviews, usability testing and close observation to uncover these patterns, then translate them into clearer information architecture, decision points and interaction flows. Street and travel photography further sharpen my attention to behaviour, context and visual composition.

c.n: I’m interested in AI not only as a design tool, but as a new layer within products and services — one that changes how people access information, make decisions and interact with complex systems. The central design challenge is defining where automation adds value, where human judgement should remain, and how a product communicates uncertainty, control and responsibility.
c.tx: I’m interested in AI not only as a design tool, but as a new layer within products and services — one that changes how people access information, make decisions and interact with complex systems. The central design challenge is defining where automation adds value, where human judgement should remain, and how a product communicates uncertainty, control and responsibility.

c.n: I explore AI-assisted workflows in research, synthesis, ideation and prototyping, while applying the same questions to product design: What should the system do, what should the user decide, and how can the interaction remain understandable and trustworthy?
c.tx: I explore AI-assisted workflows in research, synthesis, ideation and prototyping, while applying the same questions to product design: What should the system do, what should the user decide, and how can the interaction remain understandable and trustworthy?

c.n: I’m drawn to questions that sit beyond immediate product roadmaps: how changes in technology, behaviour and society could create new needs, interaction models and services. I look for weak signals and connections across different fields, but treat them as inputs for structured exploration rather than predictions.
c.tx: I’m drawn to questions that sit beyond immediate product roadmaps: how changes in technology, behaviour and society could create new needs, interaction models and services. c.n: Real-time dashboard that turns an office air-quality sensor's raw readings into one glanceable score anyone can act on.
c.tx: Real-time dashboard that turns an office air-quality sensor's raw readings into one glanceable score anyone can act on.

c.n: An office air-quality sensor produced raw technical readings (CO₂, particulates, humidity) that  non-expert office workers couldn't interpret - the numbers didn't answer the main question:  what effect does it have on us?
c.tx: An office air-quality sensor produced raw technical readings (CO₂, particulates, humidity) that  non-expert office workers couldn't interpret - the numbers didn't answer the main question:  what effect does it have on us?

c.n: Product & UI design.  Translated a still-forming client vision into a dashboard and supporting screens in Figma, and presented the flows to the client and their developers.
c.tx: Product & UI design.  Translated a still-forming client vision into a dashboard and supporting screens in Figma, and presented the flows to the client and their developers.

c.n: Led with a single glanceable score instead of exposing raw sensor values - one number a non-specialist reads instantly, with the underlying metrics available on drill-down.
c.tx: Led with a single glanceable score instead of exposing raw sensor values - one number a non-specialist reads instantly, with the underlying metrics available on drill-down.

c.n: Delivered as the design foundation the client could evolve - I supplied a first, plausible structure for how air quality maps to productivity, deliberately as a starting point for the client to calibrate once their own data matured.
c.tx: Delivered as the design foundation the client could evolve - I supplied a first, plausible structure for how air quality maps to productivity, deliberately as a starting point for the client to calibrate once their own data matured.

c.n: A consumer app for keeping every product warranty in one place - so an expiring cover or an open claim never slips through.
c.tx: A consumer app for keeping every product warranty in one place - so an expiring cover or an open claim never slips through.

c.n: Paper warranty cards get lost and expiry dates stay invisible until it's too late - leaving people unable to claim a repair they're actually entitled to.
c.tx: Paper warranty cards get lost and expiry dates stay invisible until it's too late - leaving people unable to claim a repair they're actually entitled to.

c.n: Product & UI design.  Turned the client's goal into a full mobile flow in Figma and presented it to the client and developers.
c.tx: Product & UI design.  Turned the client's goal into a full mobile flow in Figma and presented it to the client and developers.

c.n: Built the home around what's most time-sensitive - ongoing cases and soon-to-expire warranties first, with browsing moved to a separate tab - so users immediately see what needs attention, not a catalog to dig through.
c.tx: Built the home around what's most time-sensitive - ongoing cases and soon-to-expire warranties first, with browsing moved to a separate tab - so users immediately see what needs attention, not a catalog to dig through.

c.n: Designed the onboarding concept myself - electronic warranty delivery right after purchase - which the client adopted. Delivered as a complete design; the product wasn't taken to launch.
c.tx: Designed the onboarding concept myself - electronic warranty delivery right after purchase - which the client adopted. Delivered as a complete design; the product wasn't taken to launch.

c.n: A redesign of a live pharmacy webshop - custom storefront, map-based pharmacy picker, and a distinct prescription mode.
c.tx: A redesign of a live pharmacy webshop - custom storefront, map-based pharmacy picker, and a distinct prescription mode.

c.n: A pharmacy needed more than a standard webshop: a storefront that also carries a blog and news, plus a hard requirement that users can only add to cart after choosing their preferred pharmacy.
c.tx: A pharmacy needed more than a standard webshop: a storefront that also carries a blog and news, plus a hard requirement that users can only add to cart after choosing their preferred pharmacy.

c.n: Owned the UI redesign.  Designed a custom homepage that blends shop, blog and news, and a map-based pharmacy picker that fits the platform's per-pharmacy pricing model.
c.tx: Owned the UI redesign.  Designed a custom homepage that blends shop, blog and news, and a map-based pharmacy picker that fits the platform's per-pharmacy pricing model.

c.n: Turned two hard constraints into clear signals: a map picker that front-loads the required pharmacy choice, and a brand-colour shift marking prescription mode (legally, those items can't be delivered).
c.tx: Turned two hard constraints into clear signals: a map picker that front-loads the required pharmacy choice, and a brand-colour shift marking prescription mode (legally, those items can't be delivered).

c.n: Live and in production - the redesigned storefront is the pharmacy's active online shop today.
c.tx: Live and in production - the redesigned storefront is the pharmacy's active online shop today.

c.n: A ground-up redesign of a live internal tool - turning a dense, complex time-and-finance system into a usable interface.
c.tx: A ground-up redesign of a live internal tool - turning a dense, complex time-and-finance system into a usable interface.

c.n: An internal company tool. Connecting time tracking with financial reporting had grown visually messy and hard to use - some parts were already live, so the redesign had to fix a working system, not start from a blank page.
c.tx: An internal company tool. Connecting time tracking with financial reporting had grown visually messy and hard to use - some parts were already live, so the redesign had to fix a working system, not start from a blank page.

c.n: Owned the UI and design-system work. Shaped how the interface should work together with the product owner, then built the visual system on a complex variant-rich Figma base, including a full dark mode mapped to the light palette.
c.tx: Owned the UI and design-system work. Shaped how the interface should work together with the product owner, then built the visual system on a complex variant-rich Figma base, including a full dark mode mapped to the light palette.

c.n: Tackled the density problem head-on: designed the table layouts and a colour-coding system so managers could scan overtime, allocations and time-off at a glance - trading visual quietness for fast comparability.
c.tx: Tackled the density problem head-on: designed the table layouts and a colour-coding system so managers could scan overtime, allocations and time-off at a glance - trading visual quietness for fast comparability.

c.n: Some features shipped to production - the redesign moved a live internal system from "unusable" toward something the team could actually work in.
c.tx: Some features shipped to production - the redesign moved a live internal system from "unusable" toward something the team could actually work in.

c.tx: An on-demand app connecting people with local service professionals - designed end-to-end from the client's brief into a working flow.

c.tx: The client had a clear vision for a service-matching app but needed it turned into a real, end-to-end user flow - from finding a professional  to creating and tracking a task.

c.tx: Owned the UI design, working from the client's specific concept. Designed the full journey - registration, search, professional profiles, task creation and tracking - and presented the screens along the way.
